examples.scenario: Internal users receive phishing emails masquerading as IT support notifications prompting urgent password resets. The email contains a credential harvesting link pointing to a domain mimicking the corporate identity provider login page, resulting in multiple compromised accounts.

indicators: Suspicious domain: login-support.reset-idp.com mimics legitimate IDP
Phishing URL with multiple subdomain levels to obfuscate
Unusual source IP 192.168.101.12 accessing reset page
Login from external IP 203.0.113.58 shortly after link click
WAF detection of credential harvesting pattern on /reset endpoint
examples.detection_method: Correlation of phishing email detection (via email gateway and SPF/DKIM checks), WAF alerts on suspicious URL patterns, monitoring for anomalous login IP addresses and failed login attempts triggering account lockout policies, and conditional access policies enforcing MFA on password resets.
